hindi: देव द्रविणोदा तुम्हारे लिए भरे हुए आसेचन की इच्छा करे। ऊपर उँडेलो, अथवा भर दो; तब देव तुम्हारे पास ले आता है।
english: Let the god Draviṇodas (the wealth-giver) desire for you the full pouring. Pour it up, or fill it up; then the god brings [it] to you.

text_flags.why: possible: the printed -ñj- before dhv is probably a spelling variant of siñcadhvam (as in the Ṛgveda); same verb √sic

notes: ohate is uncertain (3 sg. mid. of √uh/√vah, 'brings, bestows, attends to'); the object is not expressed, so 'his favour' is a supplied reading. āsicam is read as accusative of āsic- 'pouring, libation' agreeing with pūrṇām. Draviṇodas is kept as a name; the line does not say which god is meant.
lines_deva: देवो वो द्रविणोदाः पूर्णां विवष्ट्वासिचम्
उद्वा सिञ्जध्वमुप वा पृणध्वमादिद्वो देव ओहते
lines_iast: devo vo draviṇodāḥ pūrṇāṃ vivaṣṭvāsicam
udvā siñjadhvamupa vā pṛṇadhvamādidvo deva ohate

hindi: ब्रह्मणस्पति आगे बढ़ें, देवी सूनृता आगे बढ़ें; देवगण हमारे यज्ञ को उस वीर पुरुष की ओर ले जाएँ जो पाँच प्रकार के दानवाला है।
english: Let Brahmaṇaspati go forth, let the goddess Sūnṛtā go forth; may the gods lead our sacrifice towards the manly hero of fivefold bounty.
notes: naḥ may be 'our' (with yajñam) or 'for us'. paṅkti-rādhas 'of fivefold bounty' is literal; the sense of the fivefold gift is not stated. Brahmaṇaspati and Sūnṛtā are kept as names.
lines_deva: प्रैतु ब्रह्मणस्पतिः प्र देव्येतु सूनृता
अच्छा वीरं नर्यं पङ्क्तिराधसं देवा यज्ञं नयन्तु नः
lines_iast: praitu brahmaṇaspatiḥ pra devyetu sūnṛtā
acchā vīraṃ naryaṃ paṅktirādhasaṃ devā yajñaṃ nayantu naḥ

hindi: हमारी सहायता के लिए सीधे खड़े हो जाओ, सविता देव के समान; सीधे खड़े, वाज के विजेता, जब हम अभिषेकों के साथ पुरोहितों सहित तुम्हें पुकारते हैं।
english: Stand up, upright, for our help, like the god Savitṛ; upright, winner of the prize, when we call upon you with anointings, with the priests.
notes: The addressee is not named in the verse. añjibhiḥ is read as 'with anointings/unguents'; vāghadbhiḥ 'with the priests' (vāghat); the exact sense of both is open. ṇa is naḥ with retroflexed n.
lines_deva: ऊर्ध्व ऊ षु ण ऊतये तिष्ठा देवो न सविता
ऊर्ध्वो वाजस्य सनिता यदञ्जिभिर्वाघद्भिर्विह्वयामहे
lines_iast: ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇa ūtaye tiṣṭhā devo na savitā
ūrdhvo vājasya sanitā yadañjibhirvāghadbhirvihvayāmahe

hindi: जो मनुष्य धन की ओर आगे ले जाना चाहता है और जो तुम्हारी, हे वसु, उपासना करता है, हे अग्नि, वह स्तुति करने वाले, स्वयं सहस्र गुना पोषण करने वाले वीर को पाता है।
english: The mortal who wishes to lead forward to wealth, who worships you, O good one — he obtains, O Agni, a hero who recites praises, who of himself brings thousandfold prosperity.
notes: '~' in ukthaśa~sinaṃ is the candrabindu standing for anusvāra. agna is agne (e becomes a before a vowel). 'vīra' may mean son or hero; dhatte could be 'holds, wins'. The translation keeps the literal reading.
lines_deva: प्र यो राये निनीषति मर्तो यस्ते वसो दाशत्
स वीरं धत्ते अग्न उक्थशँसिनं त्मना सहस्रपोषिणम्
lines_iast: pra yo rāye ninīṣati marto yaste vaso dāśat
sa vīraṃ dhatte agna ukthaśa~sinaṃ tmanā sahasrapoṣiṇam

hindi: तुम्हारी अनेक देवभक्त प्रजाओं के उस सदा सक्रिय अग्नि को हम सुन्दर स्तुतियों और वचनों से चुनते हैं, जिसे दूसरे भी प्रज्वलित करते हैं।
english: We choose forth, with fair hymns and words, Agni, the ever-active one of your many god-seeking clans, whom others too kindle.
notes: '~' marks the candrabindu for anusvāra (agni~ = agnim; ya~ = yaṃ). anya is anye before a vowel. vaḥ may be 'your' (with viśām) or 'for you'. sam ... indhate is a split verb (tmesis).
lines_deva: प्र वो यह्वं पुरूणां विशां देवयतीनाम्
अग्निँ सूक्तेभिर्वचोभिर्वृणीमहे यँसमिदन्य इन्धते
lines_iast: pra vo yahvaṃ purūṇāṃ viśāṃ devayatīnām
agni~ sūktebhirvacobhirvṛṇīmahe ya~samidanya indhate

words.gloss: of what is rich in cattle

hindi: यह अग्नि उत्तम वीर्य और सौभाग्य का स्वामी है; वह धन का, उत्तम सन्तान का, गौओं से भरपूर का और शत्रुओं के वधों का स्वामी है।
english: This Agni is master of good heroic strength and of good fortune; he is master of wealth, of good offspring, of what is rich in cattle, and of the slayings of foes (vṛtra).
notes: vṛtra is the foe/obstacle (also the name Vṛtra). gomataḥ is read as genitive of gomat 'rich in cattle', with an unexpressed noun.
lines_deva: अयमग्निः सुवीर्यस्येशे हि सौभगस्य
राय ईशे स्वपत्यस्य गोमत ईशे वृत्रहथानाम्
lines_iast: ayamagniḥ suvīryasyeśe hi saubhagasya
rāya īśe svapatyasya gomata īśe vṛtrahathānām

hindi: हे अग्नि, तुम गृहपति हो, तुम हमारे यज्ञ में होता हो; तुम पोता हो, हे सबके वांछित, तुम ज्ञानी हो; तुम यजन करते हो और वांछनीय की ओर जाते हो।
english: You, O Agni, are the lord of the house; you are our priest at the rite. You are the Potṛ, O all-desired, wise one; you sacrifice, and you go to what is desirable.

text_flags.why: possible: tākṣi gives no clear sense here (perhaps √takṣ 'fashion'), while yakṣi 'you sacrifice' fits the line; the drafter cites the Ṛgveda parallel (2.1.2) as reading yakṣi

notes: tākṣi is unclear; yakṣi is a conjecture from the parallel verse, so the second line is tentative. If tākṣi is kept (√takṣ), the clause would be 'you fashion'. 'stva~' = stvam (candrabindu for anusvāra).
lines_deva: त्वमग्ने गृहपतिस्त्वँ होता नो अध्वरे
त्वं पोता विश्ववार प्रचेता ताक्षि यासि च वार्यम्
lines_iast: tvamagne gṛhapatistva~ hotā no adhvare
tvaṃ potā viśvavāra pracetā tākṣi yāsi ca vāryam

hindi: मित्र बनकर हम मरणशील मनुष्यों ने सहायता के लिए तुम्हें देव को चुना है — अपां नपात् को, जो सौभाग्यशाली, उत्तम कर्म करने वाला, शीघ्र विजय पाने वाला और निर्दोष है।
english: As friends we mortals have chosen you, the god, for help — the Son of the Waters, fortunate, of fair deeds, swift to prevail, faultless.
notes: apāṃ napāt is the fixed epithet 'Son of the Waters'. '~' marks candrabindu for anusvāra (napāta~ = napātam, etc.). The verse does not say which god is meant.
lines_deva: सखायस्त्वा ववृमहे देवं मर्तास ऊतये
अपां नपातँ सुभगँ सुदँससँ सुप्रतूर्तिमनेहसम्
lines_iast: sakhāyastvā vavṛmahe devaṃ martāsa ūtaye
apāṃ napāta~ subhaga~ suda~sasa~ supratūrtimanehasam

words.gloss: in the place of the libation (Iḍā)

hindi: आहुति डालो, हवि से सजाओ, होता गृहपति को स्थापित करो; इडा के स्थान पर नमस्कार के साथ उसकी उपासना करो जिसे हवि दी जाती है, घरों के पूज्य को।
english: Pour in the offering, adorn [him] with the oblation, install the priest, the lord of the house; at the place of the libation, with homage, worship the one to whom the oblation is given, the worshipful one of the homesteads.
notes: marjayadhvam 'cleanse/adorn' and ni ... dadhidhvam 'install' are the literal readings. The god is not named. ā ... juhota: ā is taken as a prefix of the verb ('pour in').
lines_deva: आ जुहोता हविषा मर्जयध्वं नि होतारं गृहपतिं दधिध्वम्
इडस्पदे नमसा रातहव्यँ सपर्यता यजतं पस्त्यानाम्
lines_iast: ā juhotā haviṣā marjayadhvaṃ ni hotāraṃ gṛhapatiṃ dadhidhvam
iḍaspade namasā rātahavya~ saparyatā yajataṃ pastyānām

words.gram: f. nom. sg. (s-stem, a-ūdhas); agrees with the singular ajījanat; sense uncertain

hindi: तरुण बालक की वृद्धि निश्चय ही चमकती हुई है, जो दूध पीने के लिए दोनों माताओं के पीछे नहीं जाता; जब बिना थन वाली ने उसे जन्म दिया, तब वह तुरन्त बड़ा हो गया और महान् दूतकर्म करता रहा।
english: Bright indeed is the growth of the young child, who does not follow his two mothers to suck; when the udderless one bore him, then at once he grew, performing a great messengership.
notes: anūdhā is unclear (a-ūdhas 'without udder'; number and case uncertain) and the sense of the whole comparison is tentative. The pluta figure 3 inside dūtyā3ṃ is a separate word and is not translated (dūtyā + 3 + ṃ read as dūtyam with pluta). vakṣathaḥ could also be 'bosom, flank'; 'growth' is chosen. Reviewer: ajījanat is singular, so anūdhāḥ (s-stem) is read as nom. sg. 'the udderless one'; who is meant is not stated.
lines_deva: चित्र इच्छिशोस्तरुणस्य वक्षथो न यो मातरावन्वेति धातवे
अनूधा यदजीजनदधा चिदा ववक्षत्सद्यो महि दूत्या३ं चरन्
lines_iast: citra icchiśostaruṇasya vakṣatho na yo mātarāvanveti dhātave
anūdhā yadajījanadadhā cidā vavakṣatsadyo mahi dūtyā3ṃ caran

words.gram: m. nom. sg. 'other, beyond' (sense uncertain; no typo)
m. nom. sg. (sam-veśana, from sam + √viś; not a compound of two nouns)

hindi: यह तुम्हारा एक है, और वह दूसरा तुम्हारा एक है; तीसरी ज्योति के साथ मिल जाओ। शरीर के लिए सुन्दर प्रवेश बनो, और परम जन्मस्थान में देवों के प्रिय बनो।
english: This is one of yours, and that is another one of yours; enter into union with the third light. Be a pleasant entering for the body, and dear to the gods in the highest birthplace.
notes: The addressee is not named. saṃveśana could be 'abode, resting-place'. The pluta figure 3 in tanve3 is not translated. The 'three' (one, another, third light) is taken literally.
lines_deva: इदं त एकं पर ऊ त एकं तृतीयेन ज्योतिषा सं विशस्व
संवेशनस्तन्वे३ चारुरेधि प्रियो देवानां परमे जनित्रे
lines_iast: idaṃ ta ekaṃ para ū ta ekaṃ tṛtīyena jyotiṣā saṃ viśasva
saṃveśanastanve3 cāruredhi priyo devānāṃ parame janitre

hindi: योग्य जातवेदा के लिए हम इस स्तोत्र को रथ के समान बुद्धि से रचें। क्योंकि उसकी कृपा हमारे लिए कल्याणकारी है; सभा में, हे अग्नि, तुम्हारी मित्रता में हम हानि न उठाएँ।
english: For Jātavedas, who is worthy, we would fashion this praise-song with thought, as one fashions a chariot. For his favour to us is auspicious; in the assembly, O Agni, in your friendship may we not be harmed.
notes: mahema is taken as from √mah (here 'fashion, exalt'); this is uncertain. Jātavedas is Agni (line 2 addresses Agni). '~' marks the candrabindu for anusvāra.
lines_deva: इमँ स्तोममर्हते जातवेदसे रथमिव सं महेमा मनीषया
भद्रा हि नः प्रमतिरस्य सँसद्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव
lines_iast: ima~ stomamarhate jātavedase rathamiva saṃ mahemā manīṣayā
bhadrā hi naḥ pramatirasya sa~sadyagne sakhye mā riṣāmā vayaṃ tava

words.gloss: in the order, in the rite

hindi: द्युलोक के शिर, पृथ्वी के सेवक, ऋत में उत्पन्न वैश्वानर अग्नि को — जो कवि, सम्राट् और लोगों का अतिथि है — देवगण ने मुख में पात्र के रूप में उत्पन्न किया।
english: The head of heaven, the attendant of the earth, Vaiśvānara born in the order, Agni — the seer, universal sovereign, guest of the people — the gods produced as a vessel in the mouth.

text_flags.why: possible: the Ṛgveda parallel (6.7.1) reads āsann ā pātram; the printed visarga after ā has no sandhi explanation

notes: aratiṃ is rendered 'attendant' (also 'swift one'); ṛta ā is taken as ṛte + ā; 'in the mouth' (āsan) is a reading from the parallel. Tentative. '~' marks candrabindu for anusvāra.
lines_deva: मूर्धानं दिवो अरतिं पृथिव्या वैश्वानरमृत आ जातमग्निम्
कविँ सम्राजमतिथिं जनानामासन्नाः पात्रं जनयन्त देवाः
lines_iast: mūrdhānaṃ divo aratiṃ pṛthivyā vaiśvānaramṛta ā jātamagnim
kavi~ samrājamatithiṃ janānāmāsannāḥ pātraṃ janayanta devāḥ

words.gloss: urge on, strive for the prize

hindi: जैसे पर्वत की पीठ से जल, तुमसे, हे अग्नि, देवों ने स्तुतियों के द्वारा उत्पन्न किया। उन तुम्हें स्तुतियाँ और सुन्दर प्रशंसाएँ वाज के लिए प्रेरित करती हैं, हे गीतों से वहन किए जाने वाले, जैसे दौड़ जीत चुके घोड़े।
english: Like waters from the ridge of a mountain, from you, O Agni, the gods brought forth [it] with hymns. Songs and fair praises urge you on for the prize, O one carried by songs, as horses that have won the race.

text_flags.why: possible: the epithet is normally gīrvāhaḥ; the extra -va- may be a typing slip

notes: The object of janayanta is not expressed, so the first line is tentative. The comparison in the second line (ājiṃ na ... jigyur aśvāḥ) is read loosely.
lines_deva: वि त्वदापो न पर्वतस्य पृष्ठादुक्थेभिरग्ने जनयन्त देवाः
तं त्वा गिरः सुष्टुतयो वाजयन्त्याजिं न गिर्ववाहो जिग्युरश्वाः
lines_iast: vi tvadāpo na parvatasya pṛṣṭhādukthebhiragne janayanta devāḥ
taṃ tvā giraḥ suṣṭutayo vājayantyājiṃ na girvavāho jigyuraśvāḥ

hindi: तुम्हारे यज्ञ के राजा, रुद्र, होता, दोनों लोकों के सच्चे यजन करने वाले, सुनहरे रूपवाले अग्नि को, गर्जन से पहले और असावधानी से पहले, अपनी सहायता के लिए अपना बना लो।
english: Make for yourselves, for help, before the thunder and before heedlessness, Agni — king of your rite, Rudra, the priest, true sacrificer of the two worlds, golden in form.
notes: ā ... kṛṇudhvam is read as 'make (take) to yourselves'. tanayitnoḥ and acittāt are taken as ablatives after purā ('before'); the second is uncertain ('before heedlessness'). '~' marks candrabindu for anusvāra. Rudra is kept as a name/epithet.
lines_deva: आ वो राजानमध्वरस्य रुद्रँ होतारँ सत्ययजँ रोदस्योः
अग्निं पुरा तनयित्नोरचित्ताद्धिरण्यरूपमवसे कृणुध्वम्
lines_iast: ā vo rājānamadhvarasya rudra~ hotāra~ satyayaja~ rodasyoḥ
agniṃ purā tanayitnoracittāddhiraṇyarūpamavase kṛṇudhvam

hindi: समूह का स्वामी राजा नमस्कारों के साथ प्रज्वलित किया जाता है, जिसका मुख घी से आहुत है; मनुष्य हवियों से संकट में पड़े हुए उसकी स्तुति करते हैं; अग्नि उषाओं के आगे प्रकाशित हुआ है।
english: The king, lord of the gathering, is kindled with homage — he whose front is poured upon with ghee; the men, hard-pressed, praise him with oblations; Agni has blazed at the head of the dawns.
notes: samaryaḥ is uncertain (sam-arya 'of the gathering/battle'). sabādhaḥ 'hard-pressed' could also be read 'with toil'. 'Agni' is named only in the last line; the earlier clauses are taken to refer to him. Reviewer: āgniḥ is read as ā + agniḥ (ā is the preverb of aśoci), which is regular; the word list still lacks the separate word ā (to be added by a person).
lines_deva: इन्धे राजा समर्यो नमोभिर्यस्य प्रतीकमाहुतं घृतेन
नरो हव्येभिरीडते सबाध आग्निरग्रमुषसामशोचि
lines_iast: indhe rājā samaryo namobhiryasya pratīkamāhutaṃ ghṛtena
naro havyebhirīḍate sabādha āgniragramuṣasāmaśoci

hindi: अग्नि विशाल पताका के साथ आगे चलता है; वह वृषभ दोनों लोकों में गरजता है। द्युलोक के अन्त से भी वह समीप तक पहुँच गया है; जलों की गोद में वह महान् बढ़ा है।
english: Agni goes forth with his great banner; the bull roars over the two worlds. From the very end of heaven he has reached the nearest; in the lap of the waters the mighty one has grown.
notes: Line 2 first token is a run of eight words and is split as shown. upamām 'nearest/topmost' (f. acc. sg.) has no clear noun; the meaning of the clause is tentative. 'ā rodasī' is read as 'over the two worlds'.
lines_deva: प्र केतुना बृहता यात्यग्निरा रोदसी वृषभो रोरवीति
दिवश्चिदन्तादुपमामुदानडपामुपस्थे महिषो ववर्ध
lines_iast: pra ketunā bṛhatā yātyagnirā rodasī vṛṣabho roravīti
divaścidantādupamāmudānaḍapāmupasthe mahiṣo vavardha

hindi: हे मनुष्यो, दोनों अरणियों से उँगलियों द्वारा, हाथ से छूटे हुए, प्रशंसित अग्नि को उत्पन्न करो — दूर से दीखने वाले, गृहपति, सदा सक्रिय को।
english: O men, beget Agni with your fingers from the two kindling-sticks — the praised one, dropped from the hand, seen from afar, the lord of the house, the ever-active.

text_flags.why: possible: a Ṛgveda parallel is expected to read atharyum; vya for rya may be a variant or slip

notes: The second line is short (a single pāda); the final word is uncertain (atharyu 'ever-moving, active'). hasta-cyuta 'shaken/dropped from the hand' is a literal reading of the rubbing action. araṇyoḥ is dual (the two sticks).
lines_deva: अग्निं नरो दीधितिभिरण्योर्हस्तच्युतं जनयत प्रशस्तम्
दूरेदृशं गृहपतिमथव्युम्
lines_iast: agniṃ naro dīdhitibhiraṇyorhastacyutaṃ janayata praśastam
dūredṛśaṃ gṛhapatimathavyum

words.gram: f. acc. sg. pres. part. ā-√i
m. nom. pl. pres. part. mid. √hā

hindi: लोगों के समिन्धन से अग्नि जाग उठा है, जैसे दुधारू गाय की ओर, आती हुई उषा की ओर; जैसे युवा शाखा को ऊपर उठाते हुए, उसकी किरणें आकाश की ओर आगे बहती हैं।
english: Agni has been awakened by the kindling of the people, as towards a milch-cow, towards the dawn coming; like youths sending up a branch, his rays stream forth towards the firmament.

text_flags.why: possible: the Ṛgveda parallel (5.1.1) reads sisrate; sasrate may be a typing slip or variant

notes: In the first line, prati ... uṣāsam is read as 'towards the dawn' with the comparison dhenum iva 'like a cow'. yahvā iva is read as 'like youths'.
lines_deva: अबोध्यग्निः समिधा जनानां प्रति धेनुमिवायतीमुषासम्
यह्वा इव प्र वयामुज्जिहानाः प्र भानवः सस्रते नाकमच्छ
lines_iast: abodhyagniḥ samidhā janānāṃ prati dhenumivāyatīmuṣāsam
yahvā iva pra vayāmujjihānāḥ pra bhānavaḥ sasrate nākamaccha

hindi: उसे जो बहुत जीतता है, महान् है, धारण करने वाला है, अबोधों के बीच बोधवान है, दुर्गों का भेदन करने वाला है, स्तुतियों से मार्ग दिखाने वाला है, भूरी दाढ़ी वाला है, कवच के समान धन की ज्योति वाला है — उसे बुद्धि में स्थापित करो।
english: [Praise] him who conquers much, great, [the sustainer], not foolish among the foolish, the destroyer of strongholds, leading with songs; set [him] in the thought, tawny-bearded, as if with armour, with wealth-bright flame.
notes: This verse is badly uncertain: bhūrjayantam, mahām, vipodhām, mūraiḥ, vanā, dhāḥ and vārmaṇā are all unclear, and the main verb is dhāḥ (or dhā) only by guess. The translation is a loose, tentative one and should be checked against the Ṛgveda parallel and a commentary. 'darmāṇa' = destroyer, 'hariśmaśru' = tawny-bearded.
lines_deva: प्र भूर्जयन्तं महां विपोधां मूरैरमूरं पुरां दर्माणम्
नयन्तं गीर्भिर्वना धियं धा हरिश्मश्रुं न वार्मणा धनर्चिम्
lines_iast: pra bhūrjayantaṃ mahāṃ vipodhāṃ mūrairamūraṃ purāṃ darmāṇam
nayantaṃ gīrbhirvanā dhiyaṃ dhā hariśmaśruṃ na vārmaṇā dhanarcim

hindi: तुम्हारा एक उज्ज्वल है, दूसरा पूज्य है; तुम आकाश के समान हो, जिसके दो दिन, दिन और रात, नाना रूपों वाले हैं। हे स्वधावान्, तुम सब मायाओं की रक्षा करते हो; हे पूषन्, तुम्हारा यहाँ का दान कल्याणकारी हो।
english: One of yours is bright, another of yours is worshipful; you are like the sky, with the two days (day and night) of diverse forms. You protect all wonders, O self-powered one; may your gift here be auspicious, O Pūṣan.
notes: The comparison 'viṣurūpe ahanī dyaur iva asi' (you are like the sky, with diverse-formed day and night) is read literally. māyā is rendered 'wonders, powers'; avasi 'protect' could be 'favour'.
lines_deva: शुक्रं ते अन्यद्यजतं ते अन्यद्विषुरूपे अहनी द्यौरिवासि
विश्वा हि माया अवसि स्वधावन्भद्रा ते पूषन्निह रातिरस्तु
lines_iast: śukraṃ te anyadyajataṃ te anyadviṣurūpe ahanī dyaurivāsi
viśvā hi māyā avasi svadhāvanbhadrā te pūṣanniha rātirastu

words.gram: acc. sg., bahuvrīhi (puru + daṃsa 'wonder'); with saniṃ
m. dat. sg. pres. part. mid. √hve

hindi: हे अग्नि, पुकारने वाले के लिए इडा को, बहुत आश्चर्यकर्म वाले, सदा बना रहने वाले गोधन के लाभ को सिद्ध करो। हमारे लिए फलवान् पुत्र और सन्तान हो; हे अग्नि, तुम्हारी वह सुमति हमारे साथ हो।
english: O Agni, grant to the one who calls on you Iḍā, the gain of cattle, of many wonders, most lasting. May we have a son and offspring, fruitful; O Agni, may that good will of yours be with us.
notes: Which noun purudaṃsasam qualifies (iḍām or saniṃ) is open; it is taken with saniṃ. '~' marks candrabindu for anusvāra (the final -m). Iḍā is a libation/refreshment and also a goddess name; 'Iḍā' is kept.
lines_deva: इडामग्ने पुरुदँसँ सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमँ हवमानाय साध
स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे
lines_iast: iḍāmagne puruda~sa~ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattama~ havamānāya sādha
syānnaḥ sūnustanayo vijāvāgne sā te sumatirbhūtvasme

hindi: होता प्रकट हुआ, महान्, आकाश को पाने वाला, मनुष्यों के बीच बैठने वाला; वह जलों के घुमाव में बैठा। जो निचोड़ने पर बल देता हुआ रखा गया, वह नियन्ता, उपासक को धन देता है और शरीरों का रक्षक है।
english: The priest is born forth, great, finder of the sky, sitting among men; he sat down in the turning of the waters. He who was placed, bestowing vigours at the pressing, the controller, gives goods to the worshipper and protects bodies.
notes: vivarte is rendered 'in the turning/opening' (uncertain). sute is read as 'at the pressing (of Soma)'. The person meant (Agni) is not named in the unit.
lines_deva: प्र होता जातो महान्नभोविन्नृषद्मा सीददपां विवर्ते
दधद्यो धायी सुते वयाँसि यन्ता वसूनि विधते तनूपाः
lines_iast: pra hotā jāto mahānnabhovinnṛṣadmā sīdadapāṃ vivarte
dadhadyo dhāyī sute vayā~si yantā vasūni vidhate tanūpāḥ

words.gram: f. nom. sg. pres. part. mid.

hindi: वह स्तुति करती हुई, वन्दना करती हुई, प्रशंसित सम्राट् को, असुर (स्वामी) को, पुरुषों और प्रजाओं के आनन्द के योग्य को, चाहे; जैसे इन्द्र के, बलवान् के किए हुए कर्म [चाहे जाते हैं]।
english: Let [her], praising and worshipping, desire the praised universal sovereign, the lord, to be rejoiced in by the man and the peoples; [desire] him as the deeds of mighty Indra [are desired].

text_flags.why: the printed form lacks the a after ś; praśasta 'praised'

notes: vandadvārā is unclear and the subject of vivaṣṭu is not stated; the feminine 'her' is a guess from vandamānā. The sense of the second line and puṃsaḥ kṛṣṭīnām is tentative. 'asura' is taken as 'lord'. '~' marks candrabindu for anusvāra.
lines_deva: प्र सम्राजमसुरस्य प्रश्स्तं पुँसः कृष्टीनामनुमाद्यस्य
इन्द्रस्येव प्र तवसस्कृतानि वन्दद्वारा वन्दमाना विवष्टु
lines_iast: pra samrājamasurasya praśstaṃ pu~saḥ kṛṣṭīnāmanumādyasya
indrasyeva pra tavasaskṛtāni vandadvārā vandamānā vivaṣṭu

hindi: दोनों अरणियों में रखा हुआ जातवेदा, गर्भ के समान, गर्भवती स्त्रियों द्वारा भली-भाँति धारण किया हुआ, जागरूक, हवि वाले मनुष्यों द्वारा प्रतिदिन स्तुति के योग्य अग्नि है।
english: Jātavedas, placed in the two kindling-sticks, well borne like an embryo by pregnant women, Agni is to be praised day by day by the wakeful men with their oblations.
notes: The line breaks of the last line are kept; the wakeful men are the ones with oblations (haviṣmadbhiḥ manuṣyebhiḥ agree). 'garbha iva it' is read as 'like an embryo indeed'.
lines_deva: अरण्योर्निहितो जातवेदा गर्भ इवेत्सुभृतो गर्भिणीभिः
दिवेदिव ईड्यो जागृवद्भिर्हविष्मद्भिर्मनुष्येभिरग्निः
lines_iast: araṇyornihito jātavedā garbha ivetsubhṛto garbhiṇībhiḥ
divediva īḍyo jāgṛvadbhirhaviṣmadbhirmanuṣyebhiragniḥ

hindi: हे अग्नि, तुम प्राचीन काल से यातुधानों को कुचलते हो; राक्षस युद्धों में तुम्हें नहीं जीत सके। जड़ों सहित उन भक्षकों को जला डालो; वे तुम्हारे दिव्य शस्त्र से न छूटें।
english: From of old, O Agni, you crush the sorcerers; the demons have not conquered you in battles. Burn after them, together with their roots, the devourers; let them not escape from your divine missile.
notes: kayādaḥ is uncertain ('devourers'). 'daivyāyāḥ' agrees with hetyāḥ (f.), read as 'from your divine missile'. '~' marks candrabindu for anusvāra. 'sahamūrān' is read saha + mūra ('root').
lines_deva: सनादग्ने मृणसि यातुधानान्न त्वा रक्षाँसि पृतनासु जिग्युः
अनु दह सहमूरान्कयादो मा ते हेत्या मुक्षत दैव्यायाः
lines_iast: sanādagne mṛṇasi yātudhānānna tvā rakṣā~si pṛtanāsu jigyuḥ
anu daha sahamūrānkayādo mā te hetyā mukṣata daivyāyāḥ

hindi: हे अग्नि, हे अजेय, हमारे लिए सबसे प्रबल दीप्ति ले आओ; हमारे अधिक प्रशंसनीय धन के लिए और वाज के लिए तुम मार्ग दो।
english: O Agni, bring us the mightiest splendour, O irresistible one; for our more praiseworthy wealth and for the prize you grant the path.
notes: adhrigo is taken as a vocative of adhrigu 'irresistible'. panīyase is a dative of the comparative 'more praiseworthy' and could qualify rāye. ratsi is read as 'you give, grant'. The word order and grammar of line 2 are tentative.
lines_deva: अग्न ओजिष्ठमा भर द्युम्नमस्मभ्यमध्रिगो
प्र नो राये पनीयसे रत्सि वाजाय पन्थाम्
lines_iast: agna ojiṣṭhamā bhara dyumnamasmabhyamadhrigo
pra no rāye panīyase ratsi vājāya panthām

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. ā-√hu

hindi: यदि वह मनुष्य वीर हो और अग्नि को प्रज्वलित करे, निरन्तर हवि अर्पित करता हुआ, तो वह दिव्य आश्रय प्राप्त करे।
english: If a mortal, a hero, should kindle Agni, offering oblation continuously, may he obtain divine shelter.
notes: anu ṣyāt is read as 'accordingly be'; the sense of anu and the syntax of the first clause are tentative. ānuṣak is read as an adverb 'continuously'.
lines_deva: यदि वीरो अनु ष्यादग्निमिन्धीत मर्त्यः
आजुह्वद्धव्यमानुषक्षर्म भक्षीत दैव्यम्
lines_iast: yadi vīro anu ṣyādagnimindhīta martyaḥ
ājuhvaddhavyamānuṣakṣarma bhakṣīta daivyam

hindi: तुम्हारा उज्ज्वल धुआँ ऊपर उठता है; आकाश में होकर वह चमकदार और फैला हुआ है। क्योंकि तुम सूर्य के समान कान्ति से और सुन्दरता से चमकते हो, हे पावक।
english: Your brilliant smoke rises; being in heaven, it is bright and spread out. For you shine like the sun, with brightness and beauty, O purifier.

text_flags.why: possible: the Ṛgveda parallel (ṣañ chukra) has the participle san 'being'; saṃ cchukra may be the same wording written with anusvāra

notes: saṃ is read as the participle san 'being' (uncertain); an alternative is saṃ as a prefix 'together'. cchukra is śukraḥ with the doubled c of the cch-sandhi. kṛpā is taken as 'beauty, form'.
lines_deva: त्वेषस्ते धूम ऋण्वति दिवि सं च्छुक्र आततः
सूरो न हि द्युता त्वं कृपा पावक रोचसे
lines_iast: tveṣaste dhūma ṛṇvati divi saṃ cchukra ātataḥ
sūro na hi dyutā tvaṃ kṛpā pāvaka rocase

hindi: तुम, हे अग्नि, मित्र के समान यश के स्वामी हो; हे सर्वद्रष्टा, हे वसु, तुम कीर्ति को ऐसे पुष्ट करते हो जैसे समृद्धि को।
english: You, O Agni, are master of glory, like Mitra (or a friend); you, O all-seeing one, O good one, nourish fame as one nourishes prosperity.
notes: kṣaitavat is unclear (perhaps 'like a lord of lands'); mitraḥ may be 'a friend' or the god Mitra; patyase is read as 'you are master of' (governing yaśaḥ). The translation is tentative. '~' marks candrabindu for anusvāra.
lines_deva: त्वँ हि क्षैतवद्यशोऽग्ने मित्रो न पत्यसे
त्वं विचर्षणे श्रवो वसो पुष्टिं न पुष्यसि
lines_iast: tva~ hi kṣaitavadyaśo'gne mitro na patyase
tvaṃ vicarṣaṇe śravo vaso puṣṭiṃ na puṣyasi

hindi: प्रातःकाल अग्नि, जो बहुतों का प्रिय है, प्रजा का अतिथि है, स्तुति पाए; जिस अमर में सभी मनुष्य हवि प्रज्वलित करते हैं।
english: At dawn let Agni, dear to many, the guest of the clan, be praised; in whom, the immortal, all mortals kindle the oblation.

text_flags.why: possible: ṣ for ś; the Ṛgveda parallel (5.18.1) has viśa(ḥ) stavetātithiḥ, 'of the clan'

notes: viśaḥ (read for viṣa) is taken as genitive 'of the clan'. havyaṃ ... indhate 'kindle the oblation' is literal and slightly odd (the oblation is offered into the fire); mortals may be the subject.
lines_deva: प्रातरग्निः पुरुप्रियो विष स्तवेतातिथिः
विश्वे यस्मिन्नमर्त्ये हव्यं मर्तास इन्धते
lines_iast: prātaragniḥ purupriyo viṣa stavetātithiḥ
viśve yasminnamartye havyaṃ martāsa indhate

hindi: जो सबसे अधिक ले जाने वाला है, वह अग्नि के लिए ऊँचे स्वर से गाओ, हे तेजस्वी; महान् रानी के समान तुमसे धन उठता है, तुमसे वाज उठते हैं।
english: What is best at conveying — chant that loudly to Agni, O radiant one; like a mighty queen, wealth arises from you, strengths arise from you.
notes: The first clause is read as 'chant that which is best-conveying'; bṛhat may be 'greatly' or 'loudly'. mahiṣī 'queen' (or 'mighty one') in the comparison is uncertain.
lines_deva: यद्वाहिष्ठं तदग्नये बृहदर्च विभावसो
महिषीव त्वद्रयिस्त्वद्वाजा उदीरते
lines_iast: yadvāhiṣṭhaṃ tadagnaye bṛhadarca vibhāvaso
mahiṣīva tvadrayistvadvājā udīrate

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. part. denom.

hindi: हर प्रजा के अतिथि, बहुतों के प्रिय, तुम्हारे घर के अग्नि की, वाज चाहने वाले हम, वचनों और बलवान् के विचारों से स्तुति करते हैं।
english: Desiring the prize, we praise your Agni, guest of every clan, dear to many, the one of the house, with words and with the prayers of the strong one.
notes: stuṣe is 1 sg. 'I praise' while vājayantaḥ is plural 'we desiring', so the translation uses 'we'. vacaḥ is uncertain (n. acc. sg. of vacas, or gen./abl. sg. of vac). Agni 'of the house' (duryam) is literal.
lines_deva: विशोविशो वो अतिथिं वाजयन्तः पुरुप्रियम्
अग्निं वो दुर्यं वचः स्तुषे शूषस्य मन्मभिः
lines_iast: viśoviśo vo atithiṃ vājayantaḥ purupriyam
agniṃ vo duryaṃ vacaḥ stuṣe śūṣasya manmabhiḥ

hindi: निश्चय ही महान् बल का गान तेजस्वी देव अग्नि के लिए करो, जिसे मनुष्यों ने मित्र के समान प्रशंसा के लिए आगे रखा है।
english: Indeed, chant great vigour to the radiant god, to Agni, whom mortals have placed in front for praise, like a friend (Mitra).
notes: bṛhad vayaḥ hi is read as 'indeed, great vigour' (object or goal of the chant); this is open. mitram may be 'a friend' or the god Mitra.
lines_deva: बृहद्वयो हि भानवेऽर्चा देवायाग्नये
यं मित्रं न प्रशस्तये मर्तासो दधिरे पुरः
lines_iast: bṛhadvayo hi bhānave'rcā devāyāgnaye
yaṃ mitraṃ na praśastaye martāso dadhire puraḥ

words.gloss: Ārkṣa (name or patronymic; role not stated)

hindi: हम सबसे बड़े वृत्र-हन्ता, ज्येष्ठ, आनव अग्नि के पास आए हैं; जो, हे श्रुतर्वन्, आर्क्ष में, महान् ज्वाला वाला होकर प्रज्वलित होता है।
english: We have come to Agni, the foremost, best slayer of Vṛtra, the Ānava; who, O Śrutarvan, in the Ārkṣa, is kindled with great flame.
notes: Śrutarvan and Ārkṣa are taken as names (vocative and locative); their roles are not stated here. ya sma is read as yaḥ sma (the visarga lost before s). The sense of ānavam ('of the people, of Anu') is open.
lines_deva: अगन्म वृत्रहन्तमं ज्येष्ठमग्निमानवम्
य स्म श्रुतर्वन्नार्क्षे बृहदनीक इध्यते
lines_iast: aganma vṛtrahantamaṃ jyeṣṭhamagnimānavam
ya sma śrutarvannārkṣe bṛhadanīka idhyate

hindi: जब तुम परम धर्म से उत्पन्न होकर साथ बढ़ने वालों के साथ हुए; जब अग्नि कश्यप का पिता, श्रद्धा माता और मनु कवि हुआ।
english: Born by the supreme law, when you were together with your fellow-growers; when Agni was the father of Kaśyapa, Śraddhā the mother, and Manu the seer.
notes: savṛdbhiḥ is unclear. The second line is read as a list of relations (father Agni of Kaśyapa, mother Śraddhā, Manu the sage); the grammar linking it to the first line is tentative. The addressee is not named.
lines_deva: जातः परेण धर्मणा यत्सवृद्भिः सहाभुवः
पिता यत्कश्यपस्याग्निः श्रद्धा माता मनुः कविः
lines_iast: jātaḥ pareṇa dharmaṇā yatsavṛdbhiḥ sahābhuvaḥ
pitā yatkaśyapasyāgniḥ śraddhā mātā manuḥ kaviḥ

hindi: हम राजा सोम, वरुण, अग्नि, आदित्य, विष्णु, सूर्य, ब्रह्मन् और बृहस्पति को थामते हैं।
english: We take hold of Soma the king, Varuṇa, Agni, Āditya, Viṣṇu, Sūrya (the sun), Brahman and Bṛhaspati.

text_flags.why: possible: retroflex ṇ expected (brahman acc. sg. brahmāṇam); the printed n is probably a typing slip

notes: A list of names. anvārabhāmahe 'we take hold of' (for protection) is the literal sense. rājānam is taken with Soma only. '~' marks candrabindu for anusvāra.
lines_deva: सोमँ राजानं वरुणमग्निमन्वारभामहे
आदित्यं विष्णुँ सूर्यं ब्रह्मानं च बृहस्पतिम्
lines_iast: soma~ rājānaṃ varuṇamagnimanvārabhāmahe
ādityaṃ viṣṇu~ sūryaṃ brahmānaṃ ca bṛhaspatim

hindi: यहाँ से ये ऊपर चढ़े, द्युलोक की पीठों पर चढ़ गए; विजेताओं की तरह मार्गों से आङ्गिरस द्युलोक को गए।
english: From here these have climbed up, they have ascended the backs of heaven; as conquerors along the paths, the Aṅgirases went to heaven.
notes: bhūrjayaḥ is uncertain ('conquerors' is a guess); pathaḥ is read as accusative plural 'paths'. Aṅgirases is kept as a name.
lines_deva: इत एत उदारुहन्दिवः पृष्ठान्या रुहन्
प्र भूर्जयो यथा पथोद्यामङ्गिरसो ययुः
lines_iast: ita eta udāruhandivaḥ pṛṣṭhānyā ruhan
pra bhūrjayo yathā pathodyāmaṅgiraso yayuḥ

hindi: हे अग्नि, धन के लिए, महान् दान के लिए हम तुम्हें प्रज्वलित करें। महानता के लिए वृषभ की स्तुति करो; हवन के लिए द्यावा-पृथिवी की भी।
english: O Agni, may we kindle you for wealth, for great giving. Praise, indeed, the mighty bull for greatness; and Heaven and Earth for the offering.
notes: Heaven and Earth (dyāvā pṛthivī) are taken as the accusative dual objects of īḍiṣva, but the construction of line 2 is tentative; the addressee of the imperative is not named. samidhīmahi could be subjunctive/optative of 'we would kindle'.
lines_deva: राये अग्ने महे त्वा दानाय समिधीमहि
ईडिष्वा हि महे वृषं द्यावा होत्राय पृथिवी
lines_iast: rāye agne mahe tvā dānāya samidhīmahi
īḍiṣvā hi mahe vṛṣaṃ dyāvā hotrāya pṛthivī

hindi: अथवा वह स्थापित हुआ है, जब उसने इसके बाद 'ब्रह्म' ऐसा कहा, वह (अस्पष्ट)। उसने सभी कवित्व-शक्तियों को घेर लिया, जैसे नेमि चक्र को।
english: Or he has been placed [or: has run?], when he said 'brahma' thus, that ... He has encompassed all poetic powers, as the felly encompasses the wheel.
notes: The first line is very uncertain: dadhanve (√dhā or √dhan), veru and the syntax of vocad brahmeti veru tat cannot be fixed from the text alone. The second line (encompassing all wisdoms as the felly the wheel) is clear. The translation of line 1 is a placeholder and needs a reviewer.
lines_deva: दधन्वे वा यदीमनु वोचद्ब्रह्मेति वेरु तत्
परि विश्वानि काव्या नेमिश्चक्रमिवाभुवत्
lines_iast: dadhanve vā yadīmanu vocadbrahmeti veru tat
pari viśvāni kāvyā nemiścakramivābhuvat

hindi: हे अग्नि, अपने तेज से उनके तेज को सब ओर से चूर कर दो; यातुधान राक्षस के बल को, जिसका वीर्य नीचे दबा हुआ है।
english: Against [them], O Agni, with your fierceness crush their fierceness on every side; [crush] the strength of the sorcerer, the demon, whose vigour is pressed down.
notes: prati ... śṛṇāhi is read as 'crush against'; the object of the first clause (haraḥ) is read as 'their fierceness'. nyubjavīryam is read as a bahuvrīhi qualifying balam, 'whose vigour is overturned/pressed down'. Tentative.
lines_deva: प्रत्यग्ने हरसा हरः शृणाहि विश्वतस्परि
यातुधानस्य रक्षसो बलं न्युब्जवीर्यम्
lines_iast: pratyagne harasā haraḥ śṛṇāhi viśvataspari
yātudhānasya rakṣaso balaṃ nyubjavīryam

hindi: हे अग्नि, तुम यहाँ वसुओं, रुद्रों और आदित्यों का यजन करो, और उत्तम यज्ञ वाले, मनु से उत्पन्न, घी से सींचे हुए जन का भी।
english: You, O Agni, here worship the Vasus, the Rudras and the Ādityas; and the people of fair rite, born of Manu, sprinkled with ghee.
notes: Vasus, Rudras and Ādityas are kept as names of groups. '~' marks candrabindu for anusvāra (vasū~r, rudrā~ = vasūn, rudrān). 'janam ... ghṛtapruṣam' is read as an object of yaja, parallel to the three groups.
lines_deva: त्वमग्ने वसूँरिह रुद्राँ आदित्याँ उत
यजा स्वध्वरं जनं मनुजातं घृतप्रुषम्
lines_iast: tvamagne vasū~riha rudrā~ ādityā~ uta
yajā svadhvaraṃ janaṃ manujātaṃ ghṛtapruṣam
